reviews.title: Great drive, fast and 500 GB of storage
reviews.comment: I buy enclosures and make my own external hard drives.  This one worked great, has 500 GB of storage and is fast.  I later used it in an older iMac to replace the Fusion Drive and extended the life of a computer I was taking apart to throw away.
reviews.author: jnoel54flma

reviews.title: Good for older devices
reviews.comment: I purchased this to replace the original HDD in my 2012 Mac Mini, and it worked perfectly. The speed is great, and has great performance for Windows via Bootcamp. Installation was easy, my only complaint is that the drive wobbles a bit when placed without a spacer internally.
reviews.author: Ryan

reviews.title: Great deal
reviews.comment: This worked great so far!! Love it , I was able to free up my new computer!! Cheers. And they didn’t ship in the product box! Kudos

reviews.title: Well rounded SSD
reviews.comment: Solid product for sata Desktops or laptops, I have had no failures for the customers ive installed or cloned their old HDD to this SSD. They also are must faster compared to any mechanical drive well worth the price.

reviews.title: Good Value and a solid product.
reviews.comment: Great drive for the price. Relatively consistent in performance testing after install and OS/End User Configs. We perform quarterly hardware testing and performance has been within acceptable ranges.
